question: Determine which three lowest-level Reactome pathways (with TAS evidence) have the highest chi-squared statistics, considering only Homo sapiens targets associated with sorafenib under the conditions that the median assay value is ≤ 100 and both low and high assay values are ≤ 100 or null. For each of these three pathways, how many of these targets and non-targets lie within the pathway and outside it?
sql:
WITH 
sorafenib_targets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157
      AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
target_pe AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
    WHERE pe.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets)
),
all_pe_with_tas AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ptp.pe_stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptp
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON ptp.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
    WHERE ptp.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND pv.lowest_level = TRUE
),
targets_in_universe AS (
    SELECT pe.stable_id
    FROM target_pe pe
    WHERE pe.stable_id IN (SELECT pe_stable_id FROM all_pe_with_tas)
),
pathway_pe AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ptp.pathway_stable_id, ptp.pe_stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptp
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON ptp.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
    WHERE ptp.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND pv.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.pathway_stable_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as a,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NULL THEN 1 END) as c
    FROM pathway_pe pp
    LEFT JOIN targets_in_universe tp ON pp.pe_stable_id = tp.stable_id
    GROUP BY pp.pathway_stable_id
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targets_in_universe) as total_targets,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_pe_with_tas) as total_all_pe
),
chi_sq_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.pathway_stable_id,
        pv.name as pathway_name,
        pc.a as targets_within,
        tc.total_targets - pc.a as targets_outside,
        pc.c as non_targets_within,
        (tc.total_all_pe - tc.total_targets) - pc.c as non_targets_outside,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            tc.total_all_pe * POWER(
                (pc.a * ((tc.total_all_pe - tc.total_targets) - pc.c)) - 
                ((tc.total_targets - pc.a) * pc.c),
                2
            ),
            SAFE_MULTIPLY(tc.total_targets, SAFE_MULTIPLY(tc.total_all_pe - tc.total_targets, SAFE_MULTIPLY(pc.a + pc.c, (tc.total_targets - pc.a) + (tc.total_all_pe - tc.total_targets) - pc.c)))
        ) as chi_sq
    FROM pathway_counts pc
    CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON pc.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        pathway_stable_id, 
        pathway_name, 
        targets_within, 
        targets_outside, 
        non_targets_within, 
        non_targets_outside,
        chi_sq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY chi_sq DESC) as rn
    FROM chi_sq_calc
)
SELECT pathway_stable_id, pathway_name, chi_sq as chi_squared, targets_within, targets_outside, non_targets_within, non_targets_outside
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
